app.title: SpinShot
app.tagline: Spin it. Do it. Or pay the penalty.

howToPlaySteps: Everyone else joins with the room code
Before you start, agree on your house penalty — 10 push-ups, a silly dance, a sip of your drink, you choose
Complete the challenge — or take the penalty!
Most challenges completed wins the night

disclaimer.title: Before we start
disclaimer.message: SpinShot is a party game for groups of friends, ages 17+. Play respectfully: nobody has to do anything they're not comfortable with, and skipping is always OK.
disclaimer.note: If your group plays with drinks, please drink responsibly and never drink and drive.
